headline: CHILE SNOWFALL KNOCKS ANGLO AMERICAN COPPER 5% IN Q3 — Los Bronces Halted; 2026 Guidance Held at 700-760kt
snippet: Anglo American's Q3 2026 production report, published October 20, shows copper output fell 5% year-on-year to 174,900 tonnes as record snowfall forced mill shutdowns at Los Bronces in Chile and grade headwinds hit Collahuasi (attributable down 11%). Despite the quarterly miss, Anglo held its 2026 copper guidance at 700–760 kt and improved its unit cost guidance to approximately 139 c/lb — a detail that will matter to junior copper developers watching whether the major's cost discipline signals continued project investment appetite.

headline: GOLD HITS FOURTH STRAIGHT DOWN SESSION AT $4,120 — Oil-Fed FOMC Rate Fears Hammer Newmont, Agnico Eagle, Kinross
snippet: Spot gold extended its slide to approximately $4,120 on October 21 — a fourth consecutive losing session — as Brent crude holding near five-month highs kept Treasury yields elevated and amplified market pricing for a Federal Reserve rate hike at the October 27–28 FOMC. Senior gold miners Newmont, Agnico Eagle, and Kinross are all under pressure, with the 10-year yield near 5.14% and the US dollar around 102; analysts identify the FOMC decision as the binary catalyst that determines whether gold holds the $4,100 support level or tests lower.

headline: CHINA MAGNET EXPORTS HIT 2026 RECORD IN SEPT — Buyers Rush Before Nov 10 RE Control Deadline: SMM
snippet: China's rare earth permanent magnet exports hit a 2026 monthly record in September, driven by a concentrated backlog release as buyers front-ran the November 10 expiry of Beijing's one-year suspension of expanded export controls. SMM analysis notes that the surge partly reflects regulatory easing that allowed delayed shipments to clear — meaning October and November volumes could drop sharply once the stockpile is exhausted and the policy outcome on the November 10 deadline becomes known.

headline: BLOOMBERGNEF: $332 BILLION IN NEW COPPER MINES NEEDED BY 2028 OR DEFICIT HITS — 17-Year Development Pipeline Is the Problem
snippet: BloombergNEF's Transition Metals Outlook 2026, published October 20, calculates that copper requires approximately $332 billion in new mine investment to prevent a structural deficit beginning in 2028 — a figure that underscores why the 17-year average mine development timeline is the central problem. With nine of ten key transition metals recovering adequately in supply, copper is the exception; the BNEF analysis arrives as LME Week concentrate treatment charges are already at record-negative levels, signalling current mine supply is already strained.

headline: CORE LITHIUM'S BLACKBEARD DRILLS 92M AT 1.25% Li₂O — Longest High-Grade Intercept Yet Near Finniss Plant
snippet: Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) reported 92 metres at 1.25% Li2O in the latest drilling at the Blackbeard zone adjacent to its Finniss lithium plant in the Northern Territory — the longest high-grade intersection recorded at the deposit. The intercept includes 73 metres at 1.45% Li2O and confirms thick, continuous spodumene mineralisation that could support a resource expansion meaningful enough to extend Finniss plant life; assays for an additional 67 metres of pegmatite in NMRD108 are still pending.

headline: LITHIUM PLUS MINERALS: A$325M NPV AND 75% IRR FOR LEI DSO — Darwin Port Offtake MOU Signals NT Lithium Future
snippet: Lithium Plus Minerals (ASX: LPM) released a scoping study for the direct-shipping ore stage of its Lei lithium project in the Northern Territory, returning an after-tax NPV of A$325 million, a 75.4% IRR, and a 1.8-year capital payback on A$87.7 million upfront capex. A non-binding offtake MOU covering 50% of production with Canmax and a Darwin Port Heads of Agreement are in place; the study positions Lei as a low-capital-intensity entry point into the lithium supply chain ahead of a potential concentrator build.

headline: GREAT DIRT DEFINES THREE PRIORITY LITHIUM TARGETS IN PILBARA — First Drilling to Follow Spodumene Soil Anomaly Survey
snippet: Great Dirt Resources (ASX: GR8) identified nine lithium anomalies — including three Priority 1 drill targets — from soil sampling across its 100%-owned Pilbara lithium project in Western Australia. The company will now move to first drilling at a project located in the same region as hard-rock lithium producers including Pilbara Minerals and Mineral Resources, where spodumene pegmatite systems have proven amenable to rapid resource definition.

headline: TRACTION URANIUM COMPLETES AURORA INITIAL DRILLING IN OREGON — State Permits Pending Before Main Program; PFS Target H2 2027
snippet: Traction Uranium completed its initial drill program at the Aurora uranium project in Oregon, where 32.75 million pounds Indicated and 4.98 million pounds Inferred already define a substantial resource base. Additional drilling awaits state permit approvals from Oregon, and the company targets a Pre-Feasibility Study in the second half of 2027 — joining a growing queue of US domestic uranium projects racing to demonstrate permitted capacity ahead of the widening gap between contract prices at record $96/lb long-term and available domestic supply.

headline: LOTUS RESOURCES' FIRST U3O8 SHIPMENT STALLED AT KAYELEKERA — One Missing Namibian Transit Permit Blocks 144,000 Lbs
snippet: Lotus Resources' inaugural uranium export from Malawi's Kayelekera mine is stalled: four sealed containers holding approximately 144,000 pounds of U3O8 are blocked at site because one Namibian transit authorisation remains outstanding. Kayelekera is one of Africa's few past-producing uranium mines now restarted, and the shipment delay — a paperwork bottleneck, not a production issue — highlights the logistical complexity of landlocked African uranium projects that must route material through multiple jurisdictions.

headline: GOLDINXS DRILLS FISHPOT FOR FIRST TIME — Maiden Diamond Program Tests Gold-Silver, Copper-Gold Targets in Blackwater Belt BC
snippet: GoldInxs (TSX-V: INXS) commenced the first modern drill program at its Fishpot Project in central British Columbia, an area with only 378 historical metres completed across two old holes on a 5,509-hectare land package sitting in the same mineral belt as Artemis Gold's Blackwater Mine. The inaugural diamond drill program of up to 2,000 metres follows 3D induced polarization surveys that refined multiple gold-silver and copper-gold targets; first assays are the next catalyst.

headline: VISIONARY COPPER WINS PINE BAY PERMITS IN MANITOBA — Flin Flon High-Grade Cu-Au Project Moves to Active Exploration
snippet: Visionary Copper and Gold (TSX-V: VCG) received exploration work permits from Manitoba for its Pine Bay copper-gold project in the Flin Flon Mining District, clearing the path to an active field season. The Flin Flon district, straddling the Manitoba-Saskatchewan border, produced over 150 million tonnes of copper-zinc-gold ore from its historic VMS deposits; Pine Bay's high-grade copper-gold showing sits in prospective stratigraphy that drew renewed critical-metals attention as the US-Canada supply chain alignment prioritises North American copper sources.

headline: KLONDIKE GOLD WRAPS 2026 SEASON AND BANKS MONTANA CREEK ROYALTIES — Yukon Resource Update Slated for H1 2027
snippet: Klondike Gold (TSX-V: KG) completed its 2026 drill program at the Klondike District Gold Project in Yukon and announced additional gold royalty positions at Montana Creek, with an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate incorporating five years of drilling targeted for release in the first half of 2027. The company's multi-year, systematic drill campaign in the Klondike Schist gold belt is building toward what management expects will be a materially larger resource estimate versus the current model.

headline: CANEX METALS WINS BLM PERMIT FOR 86 DRILL PADS AT GOLD BASIN ARIZONA — RC Drilling Set for Mid-November Start
snippet: CANEX Metals received a notice-level exploration permit from the US Bureau of Land Management for its Gold Basin property in northwestern Arizona, authorising up to 86 drill pads over a two-year extendable term; a reverse circulation drill contract is signed with drilling expected to start in the second half of November 2026. Gold Basin sits in a district of historic alluvial and hard-rock gold production; the maiden RC program will be CANEX's first systematic drill test of targets generated from surface mapping and sampling.
